item.title: Bishop Aba pledges to bring the word of God to every corner of Auki Diocese
item.description: Bishop Jacob Aba has been ordained as the new shepherd of the Catholic Diocese of Auki, Malaita Province pledging to bring the word of God to every corner of the diocese.
